question.text: Under the SEBI Stewardship Code for AIFs, Principle 1 in respect of their listed-equity investments requires an AIF to:

answer.text: Formulate a comprehensive stewardship-responsibilities policy, publicly disclose it, and review and update it periodically

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.54, Principle 1 of the SEBI Stewardship Code requires AIFs, in respect of their listed-equity investments, to formulate a comprehensive policy on the discharge of their stewardship responsibilities, publicly disclose it, and review and update it periodically. The Trap: The other options describe investment-mandate, distribution, or hedging rules and are not what Principle 1 of the Stewardship Code requires. Note: The Principle 1 wording (formulate policy, public disclosure, periodic review and update) is taken directly from workbook p.54.
